action_requested: Create A2A bridge integration test suite

context.goal: The A2A bridge (_A2A_QUEUE/a2a-bridge.py) has been silently failing dispatches due to incorrect CLI flags (e.g., codex --no-stream which doesn't exist in v0.144.5; the current code uses 'codex exec -s workspace-write' which IS correct but has no test coverage). Create a Python test suite at _A2A_QUEUE/test-a2a-bridge.py that: (1) tests packet parsing with various formats (flat a2a-dispatch.sh format, wrapped a2a2a_message format), (2) tests safety_scan() with Tier A/B/C/X cases, (3) tests find_cli() for codex/claude/opencode, (4) tests build_receipt() output schema, (5) tests mask_secrets() with various secret patterns. Use only Python stdlib unittest (no external deps). Mock subprocess.run for CLI dispatch tests — do NOT actually invoke any CLI tools. Run the tests with python3 -m pytest or python3 -m unittest to verify they pass.
constraints: do not invoke CLI tools — mock all subprocess calls
deliverables: Comprehensive test suite covering packet parsing, safety gates, CLI discovery, receipt building, secret masking
All tests pass with python3 -m unittest
